sentences: The session ran V1's own hand rule (any hand in the box): no distance threshold to compare.
Frame-to-hold here is t_hold_packet - t_frame_pump, a lower bound of the public t_hold_packet - t_capture: no camera recorder ran, so no component logged the capture time.

V1's hand monitor reads its frames from the runner's frame pump, so today the watchdog's pixels are supplied by the policy host; the hand detector runs separately, but the hold decision, the chain and the policy run in one process, the runner; Part 3 moves the camera, the decision and the record to the watchdog's own computer.
Each S says how far a demonstration threshold falls short under that geometry; neither is a safety claim, and d (and H unless set) is assumed, not measured.
The record locates; it does not diagnose. A worn gripper and a bad policy look the same in a window.

rows.method: t_hold - frame_t in ms, as V1 logs it (t_hold_minus_frame_t_ms). frame_t: time.time() in the runner's frame pump after the cv2 read and the JPEG encode of the frame the triggering hand message was computed on (frame_pump.py:96). t_hold: time.time() right after goals := present returned, retried up to 3 times 50 ms apart (motion.py:166). Includes the hand-off through /tmp/khv, the hand monitor's inference and UDP send, up to one control period (66.7 ms), the monitor evaluation and the hold write. Excludes camera exposure, readout and driver buffering, the JPEG encode, and the servos coming to rest. Defined only for monitor-7 freezes; both times are the same host's wall clock. Percentiles by nearest rank over the monitor-7 freezes of the window that carry the value.
rows.name: frame_to_hold_ms

rows.method: t_hold - frame_t in ms, as V1 logs it (t_hold_minus_frame_t_ms). frame_t: time.time() in the runner's frame pump after the cv2 read and the JPEG encode of the frame the triggering hand message was computed on (frame_pump.py:96). t_hold: time.time() right after goals := present returned, retried up to 3 times 50 ms apart (motion.py:166). Includes the hand-off through /tmp/khv, the hand monitor's inference and UDP send, up to one control period (66.7 ms), the monitor evaluation and the hold write. Excludes camera exposure, readout and driver buffering, the JPEG encode, and the servos coming to rest. Defined only for monitor-7 freezes; both times are the same host's wall clock. Percentiles by nearest rank over the monitor-7 freezes of the window that carry the value. Each: session, seconds into its control loop, ms.
rows.name: frame_to_hold_ms_series

camera exposure, readout and driver buffering before the frame is encoded (frame_t is after the JPEG encode)
anything outside the camera's view, and hands the arm hides from it
misses: the miss review samples windows; a sample labelled only by a model panel shows no operator-reviewed miss
frames between events in sessions recorded before M3: only the freeze photos and judge frames were stored
the judge model's reasoning beyond its stated verdict and reason
deployment: these are development sessions, most under the operator override; no field use is in them

rows.not_shown: retention for a year (storage is outside this record); the judge model's internal process; continuous recording between events before M3
rows.shown: every stop, veto, refusal, hold and release with its inputs, time and the hash of the V1 row it came from; the label and who made it; each source chain's head
rows.title: recording of data on the safety-related decision-making process (kept one year)

rows.not_shown: retention for five years; versions between sessions; who changed the code and why (no change log in this record)
rows.shown: operator keys at the menus, kills, override and layer-off sessions; per session the runner's per-file code hashes, the guard's version and hash, the judge model and rubric hashes, the registration hash
rows.title: tracing log of interventions and safety-software versions (kept five years)

rows.not_shown: deletion or replacement of a whole file (a chain shows edits, not a missing session); no signature or external timestamp; no access control
rows.shown: hash chains: V1's session chains, the labels chain, the clip index, this record's rows; verify_record.py checks all of them end to end
rows.title: protection against corruption (tamper evidence)

rows.not_shown: indicators tied to a safety case (there is none); thresholds; field data (these are development sessions); misses reviewed by the operator
rows.shown: counts and rates with their methods: stops by source, false alarms per 100 h where the operator's labels cover >= 50 %, frame-to-hold latency
rows.title: safety performance indicators: field data collection

rows.not_shown: servo stop time and distance, stop category, validation of the stop function to the standard
rows.shown: frame-to-hold time of monitor-7 freezes: the encoded frame to the write of the hold goal
rows.title: protective stop

rows.not_shown: contact forces and pressures, separation measured to the standard, body-region limits
rows.shown: the planner's standoff refusals and the estimated palm positions (12-73 mm error, V1 STATUS)
rows.title: collaborative operation: speed and separation, power and force limiting
